newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end mostly steady, fall expected.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end mostly steady, fall expected.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed unchanged on Thursday but dealers said there was plenty of liquidity on the market and rates could drop soon.
The market opened at 20.75 percent, then climbed to 21.00 percent where the bulk of deals were done, dealers said. The market closed at 21.00, unchanged from Wednesday.
"It was a mostly eventless morning but there is plenty of liquidity and I expect a decline tomorrow," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.
